title: Floyd Snelson as publicity man
summary: Allen asks about Floyd Snelson, and Albert calls him his publicity man, a great newspaper writer with a drinking problem.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: We have talked about it some, but I didn't get everything down, you know. Oh, we didn't? Yeah. Like that, you know, and every time you tell something you get more. Did you ever know a fella named Floyd Snellson?

Sure, Floyd was my publicity man. He was a great, great newspaper man, but he had a problem. Alcohol. But he was one of the greatest writers that you ever want to see. And on one of my band pictures you see Floyd Snellson leaning out of the window.
